name: Fitting-Room Skirt
text: Before bidding, your two lowest cards become aces.
archetypes: High Card, Spade Master, Contract Attacker
decision: Bidding with two extra aces: whether to bid up for them, and which suits they open, since a low spade becomes the ace of spades.
opponent: Visible before bidding; opponents answer by trumping the new aces once they show out of those suits.
aiNote: Count the two new aces when bidding.
rationale: Two twos or threes become aces, about one and a half extra tricks a round with nothing to review but two cards, which is rare-level power for a contract deck; it works against nil, which keeps it out of the nil archetypes.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced choosing between two whole hands, which asked for too much review each round.
